summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements. REQ-1 (remove snap scroll), REQ-2 (remove navigation overlays), REQ-3 (static carousel layouts), and REQ-4 (fade-up animations) appear well-addressed. REQ-5 has partial evidence — the 'View All Options' button is noted as removed in the file summary, but the Services.tsx diff is truncated so the 'expand instantly on first click' behaviour cannot be fully confirmed. The diff also introduces a scrollbar-hide CSS utility class that was not requested, though it is minor.

missing_requirements.requirement: When a main service category is clicked, all subcategory service cards must expand and display instantly with no extra click required.
missing_requirements.reason: The Services.tsx diff is truncated and only shows accordion/chevron toggle UI structure. The file summary states 'View All Options button fully removed' but the expand-on-first-click behaviour cannot be confirmed from the truncated diff. The presence of ChevronDown/ChevronUp imports and 'expandable accordion' language in the summary raises doubt about whether subcategories expand without any toggle interaction.

hallucinated_features.description: A scrollbar-hide CSS utility class was added to index.css, hiding scrollbars on elements that use it.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not request any scrollbar hiding or scrollbar styling changes; it only requested removal of snap scroll and addition of fade-up animations.
